notes: IMEA's All-State Honor Groups page carries a complete 2026-27 timeline leading to the All-State Conference at Idaho State University, Pocatello, February 3-6, 2027. Two caveats about IMEA's own wording: the page's prose sentence reads 'The 2026 All-State will be February 3-6, 2027' (IMEA labels the cycle inconsistently; the dates and the timeline are unambiguously the 2026-27 school year), and the IMEA home page listed the registration deadline as '01/06/2026' while the All-State page's timeline gives 'Audition Registration Closes - Midnight, October 9, 2026'. The timeline on the All-State page is used here. The page states 'More information will be posted as it becomes available' — as of 2026-08-07 no choral audition requirements document, fee amount, conductor list, or repertoire had been posted publicly (registration is behind a member login). Idaho's choral audition music files on idahomusiced.org (Alto I/II, Bass I, Tenor II, Jazz Choir Ex1, etc.) are not year-stamped, unlike the band files which sit in a 'band26' folder, so they were not treated as current-cycle repertoire. Separately, the Idaho chapter of ACDA (IDACDA, idacda.org) runs its own All-State Honor Choirs for elementary and junior high singers — a different organization from IMEA; only a 2026 (prior-cycle) edition was visible, so it is not recorded here.

organization.name: Idaho Music Educators Association, Inc.
organization.description: IMEA is a state division of NAfME, the National Association for Music Education. It administers Idaho's All-State Honor Groups and annual All-State Conference, a Large Group Festival, a Solo & Ensemble Festival, and scholarships and grants.

sources.name: IMEA All-State Student Audition Information Form

programs.name: IMEA All-State Choir
programs.description: One of IMEA's All-State Honor Groups (alongside Band, Orchestra, Jazz Band, and Jazz Choir). Students audition by recording, are notified of acceptance in November, receive mailed music in December, and check in for rehearsals and performances at the All-State Conference at Idaho State University in Pocatello.

dates.title: All-State check-in, rehearsals & performances
dates.description: Idaho State University, Pocatello, Idaho. Gala Concert tickets are sold through Zeffy.

requirements.title: Year in school
requirements.description: The All-State Student Audition Information Form asks students to indicate their year in school from Freshman, Sophomore, Junior, or Senior, indicating a high-school program.

requirements.title: Online registration by the director
requirements.description: Directors enter student information online; the paper Student Audition Information Form is a worksheet only and is explicitly not to be mailed. Students auditioning for more than one group indicate a first preference among Band, Choir, Jazz Band, Jazz Choir, and Orchestra.

requirements.title: Jazz Choir add-on
requirements.description: Students auditioning for the choirs are asked whether they also want to audition for the Jazz Choir; if so, they must record the additional exercises.

fees.description: IMEA's All-State timeline lists an audition fee with a due date of October 23, 2026, and separate 'Registration and Payments Due' on November 23, 2026. The amounts are not published on the public site.

programs.name: IMEA All-State Jazz Choir
programs.description: IMEA's All-State vocal jazz ensemble. Students auditioning for the choirs may elect to also audition for the Jazz Choir by recording additional exercises. Students auditioning for the Jazz Rhythm Section indicate whether they prefer the Jazz Choir or the Jazz Band.

requirements.title: Additional recorded exercises
requirements.description: Students auditioning for the choirs who also want to be considered for the Jazz Choir must record additional exercises beyond the standard choir audition.

requirements.title: Jazz Rhythm Section preference
requirements.description: Students auditioning for the Jazz Rhythm Section indicate a preference for the Jazz Choir or the Jazz Band.
